generate_distantly_supervised_data: run the script to generate distantly supervised training data from Wikipedia and QA datasets
find_answer_in_paragraph: find the best matching answer offsets from a paragraph using unigram and bigram overlap scoring
search_docs_for_answers: search ranked documents for top matching paragraphs that contain the answer to a question
nltk_entity_groups: extract all contiguous NER tagged chunks from text using NLTK named entity recognition
process_questions: generate examples for all question answer pairs using a ranker and multiprocessing pool
